symbols.limits: reads/writes: the component views in the parameters of the system's exported methods. uses: the component operations (add, remove, get, has) its per-frame update performs through the engine's out-of-line helpers, itself or in a function it calls (depth 2), with the call site; kind index: a matched method reads the type's index and the operation is not known. Not listed: operations the compiler inlined, those deeper than depth 2, and what a method that is not the update does (e.g. a SystemLoad) - read its pseudo-code; an empty writes list is not "writes nothing".

does.text: Each frame runs, in order, ProcessReloadStory, ProcessOnGameReady, ProcessSendToCampRequests, ProcessUserConnections, ProcessUserNameChanges, ProcessTriggersChanged and ProcessTransformsChanged. Then, when a system flag (byte at +0x15a) is set and no entity holds eoc::gamestate::SavegameLoadComponent, it logs 'Level loaded' and, for every entity with esv::Item and eoc::camp::ChestComponent, clears a handle in the chest's component (to the null handle), raises Item flag 2 and marks ChestComponent dirty for replication ('Clearing chest'). It removes and creates nothing itself.
does.evidence: EoCServer.dll+0x9F4130 named pseudo-code, read around the call list and the 'Level loaded' / 'Clearing chest' branch; query globals resolved through their init functions: DAT_1821f98b8 = query on SavegameLoadComponent, DAT_182230b00 = query on Item+ChestComponent, DAT_1821f218c = eoc::camp::ChestComponent type.
does.check: not checkable live: clears a handle and an Item flag on existing chests after a level load; no component appears or goes, and ChestComponent has no layout for an equals

does.text: First destroys every entity on which esv::camp::UserAssignedChestChangedEventOneFrameComponent was added (last frame's events). Then, for each queued user connection or disconnection, it looks for the user's chest: one whose reserved profile id matches the user's profile ('profileId matches chests' reservedProfileId'), else, only when at least four chests already exist, one whose user is not valid; if there is still none it creates a new chest item from the CampChestTemplate chosen by the current chest count (slots for counts 0, 1, 2 and 3, and a fifth slot for any higher count; Review 2026-11-14 (Opus, systems I): the fifth slot read at EoCServer.dll+0x9F07B0 after the four count tests) (EntityManager::CreateItem, Item flag 2, global) and adds eoc::camp::ChestComponent to it through the deferred command buffer, filling user name, user id, profile id and the index. When an assigned chest handle is valid at the end, it creates a new entity and adds esv::camp::UserAssignedChestChangedEventOneFrameComponent to it holding the user id and the chest handle ('sending ChestChanged event'). On the disconnect branch, a chest whose user has no profile is assigned to the host.
does.evidence: EoCServer.dll+0x9F07B0 named pseudo-code, read around lines 300-330 (Added-query on DAT_182230b1c = UserAssignedChestChangedEventOneFrameComponent -> DestroyEntity), 540-575, 948, 1290-1400 (CreateItem, then helper EoCServer.dll+0x9E86D0 which sets up a 0x30-byte frame storage of DAT_1821f3e24 = eoc::camp::ChestComponent) and 1440-1470 (CreateEntity, helper EoCServer.dll+0x9E8930 which sets up a 0x10-byte storage of DAT_182230b3c = esv::camp::UserAssignedChestChangedEventOneFrameComponent), guarded by the assigned-chest handle being valid.

does.text: Reacts to a party character's camp trigger changing: esv::camp::TriggerChangedEventOneFrameComponent added ('TriggerChanged event'), esv::camp::TriggerComponent added ('EnteredCamp event'), or, when a chest was just created while a character is in camp, a ChestComponent added ('ChestCreated while in camp'). For the camp region trigger involved (it must have esv::CampRegionTrigger, otherwise an assert), it hit-tests every esv::CampChestTrigger against the region, indexes them by a byte of the trigger, and for each chest item puts it on the chest trigger with the chest's index: stores that trigger's handle in the ChestComponent, clears Item flag 2, raises flag 0x400, sets the trigger's level and sets the chest's transform to the trigger's position and rotation. A chest index with no chest trigger in the region gives 'There is no CampChestTrigger available for index'.

does.text: Two passes. First, the queued requests filled by SendItemToUserChest (item, user): for each it finds the chest assigned to that user ('found chest for user') and calls MoveItemToInventory into it; a missing chest or a handle that is not an esv::Item is logged. Second, for every chest entity on which esv::one_time_reward::SendToCampChestRequestOneFrameComponent was added ('Reward request received for chest'), it creates an item for each template id listed in the request (EntityManager::CreateItem; an unknown template gives 'Item template ... was not found while creating one time reward') and moves it into that chest.
